result:
Fixed. The bug was in `sum.ts` — `sum` subtracted instead of adding:

```ts
export function sum(a: number, b: number): number {
  return a - b; // BUG: subtracts instead of adds
}
```

I changed `a - b` to `a + b` (one-line change, test file untouched).
